title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (arXiv:2210.03629v3)
key_points: 论文标题为《ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models》，作者为 Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao。
arXiv 编号 2210.03629，v1 提交于 2022-10-06，v3 修订于 2023-03-10；v3 为 ICLR camera-ready 版本（仅修正少量笔误）。
核心主张：LLM 的 reasoning（如 chain-of-thought prompting）与 acting（如 action plan generation）此前被作为独立课题研究，本文让 LLM 以交错（interleaved）方式同时生成 reasoning traces 与 task-specific actions。
协同机制：reasoning traces 帮助模型诱导、跟踪、更新行动计划并处理异常；actions 让模型与外部来源（知识库或环境）交互以收集额外信息。
在 HotpotQA 与 Fever 上，ReAct 通过与简单 Wikipedia API 交互，克服了 chain-of-thought reasoning 中普遍存在的幻觉与错误传播问题。
在两个交互式决策基准 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，ReAct 相比模仿学习与强化学习方法分别取得 34% 与 10% 的绝对成功率提升，且仅用一到两个 in-context 示例进行提示。
论文附带项目站点与代码：https://react-lm.github.io。
raw_excerpt: In this paper, we explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner, allowing for greater synergy between the two: reasoning traces help the model induce, track, and update action plans as well as handle exceptions, while actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models — 官方项目页
key_points: 项目页明确 ReAct 的动机：语言模型在 reasoning（如 chain-of-thought prompting）与 acting（如 WebGPT、SayCan、ACT-1）两方面都在进步，但这两个方向此前保持分离；ReAct 提出将这两种基础能力结合。
ReAct prompt 的构成：由 few-shot task-solving trajectories 组成，包含人工书写的 text reasoning traces 与 actions，以及针对 actions 的环境 observations。
项目页将 ReAct 的轨迹结构描述为 reasoning trace（thought）与 action 交错，并由环境返回 observation 响应 action。
对决策任务，作者设计带稀疏 reasoning traces 的人类轨迹，让 LM 自行决定何时 think、何时 act。
对比说明：reason-only baseline（即 chain-of-thought）因未接地于外部环境而受错误信息影响；act-only baseline 因缺乏推理而无法综合出最终答案；ReAct 以可解释且事实性的轨迹解决任务。
ReAct 并非完美：项目页给出 ALFWorld 上的失败示例，但指出 ReAct 格式便于人工检查与通过修改少量 model thoughts 进行行为纠正。
raw_excerpt: A ReAct prompt consists of few-shot task-solving trajectories, with human-written text reasoning traces and actions, as well as environment observations in response to actions (see examples in paper appendix!)

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models (Wei et al., 2022)
key_points: CoT 被定义为生成一条思维链，即一系列中间推理步骤（a series of intermediate reasoning steps）。
其实现方式是 few-shot prompting：在提示中提供少量思维链示范作为示例（a few chain of thought demonstrations are provided as exemplars in prompting）。
该推理能力在足够大的语言模型中自然涌现（emerge naturally in sufficiently large language models），即存在模型规模门槛。
实验覆盖三类任务：算术（arithmetic）、常识（commonsense）、符号推理（symbolic reasoning）。
用 8 条 CoT 示例提示 540B 参数模型，在 GSM8K 数学应用题基准上达到 SOTA 准确率，超过带 verifier 的微调 GPT-3。
raw_excerpt: We explore how generating a chain of thought -- a series of intermediate reasoning steps -- significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning. In particular, we show how such reasoning abilities emerge naturally in sufficiently large language models via a simple method called chain of thought prompting, where a few chain of thought demonstrations are provided as exemplars in prompting... prompting a 540B-parameter language model with just eight chain of thought exemplars achieves state of the art accuracy on the GSM8K benchmark of math word problems, surpassing even finetuned GPT-3 with a verifier.

title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners (Kojima et al., 2022)
key_points: Zero-shot CoT 的做法是在每次回答前简单加上 'Let's think step by step'，无需任何手工构造的 few-shot 示例。
单一提示模板即可跨任务泛化，覆盖算术（MultiArith, GSM8K, AQUA-RAT, SVAMP）、符号推理（Last Letter, Coin Flip）与逻辑推理（Date Understanding, Tracking Shuffled Objects）。
在 text-davinci-002 上，MultiArith 准确率从 17.7% 提升到 78.7%，GSM8K 从 10.4% 提升到 40.7%。
论文将 CoT 所针对的任务描述为不遵循标准 scaling law 的困难 System-2 任务（difficult system-2 tasks that do not follow the standard scaling laws for LLMs）。
论文将 few-shot CoT 描述为通过 step-by-step answer examples 引出复杂多步推理的技术。
raw_excerpt: we show that LLMs are decent zero-shot reasoners by simply adding "Let's think step by step" before each answer... increasing the accuracy on MultiArith from 17.7% to 78.7% and GSM8K from 10.4% to 40.7% with large InstructGPT model (text-davinci-002), as well as similar magnitudes of improvements with another off-the-shelf large model, 540B parameter PaLM.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (Yao et al., 2022)
key_points: ReAct 论文明确指出 CoT 推理存在幻觉与错误传播问题（hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning）。
该问题被归因于 CoT 缺乏与外部信息源的交互，ReAct 通过与一个简单的 Wikipedia API 交互来克服它。
论文将 reasoning（如 chain-of-thought prompting）与 acting（如 action plan generation）描述为此前主要被分开研究（primarily been studied as separate topics），即纯 CoT 属于只有 reasoning、没有 acting 的一侧。
在 ReAct 中，actions 允许模型与外部来源（如知识库或环境）交互以收集额外信息（actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information）。
ReAct 在 HotpotQA 与 Fever 上通过与 Wikipedia API 交互缓解了 CoT 的幻觉与错误传播。
raw_excerpt: ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning by interacting with a simple Wikipedia API, and generates human-like task-solving trajectories that are more interpretable than baselines without reasoning traces... their abilities for reasoning (e.g. chain-of-thought prompting) and acting (e.g. action plan generation) have primarily been studied as separate topics.

title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models (Wang et al., 2022)
key_points: 标准 CoT 使用的是朴素贪心解码（naive greedy decoding），即单条推理路径、单次前向生成。
Self-consistency 的做法是采样一组多样化的推理路径，而非只取贪心那一条（samples a diverse set of reasoning paths instead of only taking the greedy one），再对答案做边缘化投票。
Self-consistency 相对标准 CoT 的提升幅度为：GSM8K +17.9%、SVAMP +11.0%、AQuA +12.2%、StrategyQA +6.4%、ARC-challenge +3.9%，说明单路径贪心 CoT 存在明显性能上限。
论文的直觉是复杂推理问题通常存在多条通往唯一正确答案的思考路径（a complex reasoning problem typically admits multiple different ways of thinking leading to its unique correct answer）。
raw_excerpt: we propose a new decoding strategy, self-consistency, to replace the naive greedy decoding used in chain-of-thought prompting. It first samples a diverse set of reasoning paths instead of only taking the greedy one, and then selects the most consistent answer by marginalizing out the sampled reasoning paths... including GSM8K (+17.9%), SVAMP (+11.0%), AQuA (+12.2%), StrategyQA (+6.4%) and ARC-challenge (+3.9%).

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (arXiv:2210.03629v3, ICLR 2023 camera-ready)
key_points: 论文为 arXiv:2210.03629v3，作者 Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao；v1 提交于 2022-10-06，v3 为 ICLR camera-ready 版本（2023-03-10 修订）。
摘要称：在问答（HotpotQA）与事实核查（Fever）上，ReAct 通过与一个简单的 Wikipedia API 交互，克服了 chain-of-thought 推理中普遍存在的幻觉（hallucination）与错误传播（error propagation）问题。
摘要称：在两个交互式决策基准（ALFWorld 与 WebShop）上，ReAct 相对模仿学习（imitation）与强化学习（RL）方法分别取得 34% 与 10% 的绝对成功率提升，且仅使用一到两个 in-context 示例进行提示。
摘要称：ReAct 生成的类人任务求解轨迹比无推理轨迹的基线更具可解释性（interpretability）。
raw_excerpt: Concretely, on question answering (HotpotQA) and fact verification (Fever), ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning by interacting with a simple Wikipedia API... On two interactive decision making benchmarks (ALFWorld and WebShop), ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively, while being prompted with only one or two in-context examples.

title: ReAct Project Site (react-lm.github.io)
key_points: 项目页对失败模式的定性描述：reason-only 基线（即 chain-of-thought）因未接地于外部环境以获取和更新知识，只能依赖有限的内部知识，因而受错误信息（misinformation）影响。
项目页对失败模式的定性描述：act-only 基线缺乏推理能力，即使拥有与 ReAct 相同的动作与观察，也无法综合出最终答案。
项目页称 ReAct 在 ALFWorld 上并非完美，并展示了一个失败案例；同时称 ReAct 格式便于人工检查，可通过修改少量模型 thought 进行行为纠正。
项目页称 ReAct prompting 在从问答到在线购物等多种任务上取得 state-of-the-art few-shot 表现（属作者自述主张，未在已读内容中给出具体数字）。
项目页称初步微调结果显示：ReAct 是各模型规模下最佳的微调格式，且微调后的较小模型可超越提示的较大模型（属作者自述主张，未给出具体数字）。
raw_excerpt: The reason-only baseline (i.e. chain-of-thought) suffers from misinformation (in red) as it is not grounded to external environments to obtain and update knowledge, and has to rely on limited internal knowledge. The act-only baseline suffers from the lack of reasoning, unable to synthesize the final answer despite having the same actions and observation as ReAct in this case. In contrast, ReAct solves the task with a interpretable and factual trajectory.

ReAct agents are uncomplicated, prototypical agents that can be flexibly extended to many tools.

title: LlamaIndex 官方文档 — Agents (Framework Component Guides / Deploying)
key_points: LlamaIndex 将 agent 定义为「使用 LLM、memory 和 tools 处理外部用户输入的系统」，与泛指 LLM 决策系统的「agentic」相区分。
LlamaIndex 的默认 agent 类型是 FunctionAgent，它使用 LLM provider 的 function/tool calling 能力来执行工具。
ReActAgent 与 CodeActAgent 被官方文档列为「使用不同 prompting 策略执行工具的」其他类型 agent，而非默认类型。
LlamaIndex agent 的循环为：获取最新消息与聊天历史 → 发送工具 schema 与历史 → agent 返回直接回复或工具调用列表 → 执行工具调用 → 结果加入历史 → 再次调用 agent。
LlamaIndex 所有 agent 默认使用 ChatMemoryBuffer 作为 memory。
raw_excerpt: The FunctionAgent is a type of agent that uses an LLM provider's function/tool calling capabilities to execute tools. Other types of agents, such as ReActAgent and CodeActAgent, use different prompting strategies to execute tools.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
key_points: Reflexion 不更新模型权重，而是通过语言反馈（linguistic feedback）强化语言智能体。
智能体对任务反馈信号进行言语反思，并将反思文本存入情节记忆缓冲区（episodic memory buffer），以引导后续试验的决策。
该框架可整合多种反馈类型（标量值或自由文本）与来源（外部或内部模拟）。
在 HumanEval 编码基准上达到 91% pass@1，超过此前 SOTA 的 GPT-4（80%）。
raw_excerpt: reinforce language agents not by updating weights, but instead through linguistic feedback... maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer to induce better decision-making in subsequent trials... Reflexion achieves a 91% pass@1 accuracy on the HumanEval coding benchmark, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art GPT-4 that achieves 80%

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
key_points: 论文批评 LM 推理被限制在 token 级、从左到右的决策过程（token-level, left-to-right decision-making），在需要探索、策略性前瞻或初始决策关键的任务上表现不足。
ToT 泛化了流行的 Chain of Thought 方法，允许在'连贯的文本单元（thoughts）'上进行探索，作为问题求解的中间步骤。
ToT 支持多路径推理、自我评估、前瞻与回溯（backtracking）以做全局选择。
在 Game of 24 上，GPT-4 + chain-of-thought prompting 仅解出 4%，ToT 达到 74% 成功率。
raw_excerpt: generalizes over the popular Chain of Thought approach to prompting language models, and enables exploration over coherent units of text (thoughts)... perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple different reasoning paths and self-evaluating choices... looking ahead or backtracking when necessary... in Game of 24, while GPT-4 with chain-of-thought prompting only solved 4% of tasks, our method achieved a success rate of 74%

title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting: Improving Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Reasoning by Large Language Models
key_points: 论文指出 Zero-shot-CoT 存在三类缺陷：计算错误、缺失步骤错误、语义误解错误。
Plan-and-Solve (PS) Prompting 分两步：先制定计划将整个任务分解为更小的子任务，再按计划执行子任务。
PS+ 通过增加更详细的指令来改善计算错误并提升生成推理步骤的质量。
在 GPT-3 上跨 10 个数据集、3 类推理问题，零样本 PS 一致大幅优于 Zero-shot-CoT，在数学推理上可与 8-shot CoT 媲美。
raw_excerpt: it still suffers from three pitfalls: calculation errors, missing-step errors, and semantic misunderstanding errors... It consists of two components: first, devising a plan to divide the entire task into smaller subtasks, and then carrying out the subtasks according to the plan... our proposed zero-shot prompting consistently outperforms Zero-shot-CoT across all datasets by a large margin

title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
key_points: 论文指出，用提示（prompting）让具备推理能力的 LLM 在推理时使用搜索引擎往往次优，因为 LLM 可能并不完全具备'如何最优地与搜索引擎交互'的能力。
Search-R1 是 RL for reasoning 框架的扩展，让 LLM 在逐步推理过程中自主学习生成（多个）搜索查询并进行实时检索。
该方法通过多轮搜索交互优化推理轨迹，采用检索 token 掩码（retrieved token masking）保证 RL 训练稳定，并使用简单的基于结果的奖励函数（outcome-based reward）。
在 7 个 QA 数据集上，相比同设定下各种 RAG 基线，Qwen2.5-7B 提升 41%，Qwen2.5-3B 提升 20%。
raw_excerpt: Prompting advanced LLMs with reasoning capabilities to use search engines during inference is often suboptimal, as the LLM might not fully possess the capability on how to interact optimally with the search engine... the LLM learns to autonomously generate (multiple) search queries during step-by-step reasoning with real-time retrieval... Search-R1 improves performance by 41% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 20% (Qwen2.5-3B) over various RAG baselines

title: ToolRL: Reward is All Tool Learning Needs
key_points: 论文指出当前 LLM 常通过监督微调（SFT）获取工具使用能力，但 SFT 难以泛化到不熟悉或复杂的工具使用场景。
论文声称是首个针对 RL 范式下工具选择与应用任务奖励设计的全面研究，系统探索奖励策略的类型、尺度、粒度与时间动态。
论文提出面向工具使用任务的原则化奖励设计，并使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练 LLM。
实验显示相比基座模型提升 17%，相比 SFT 模型提升 15%。
raw_excerpt: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) often undergo supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to acquire tool use capabilities. However, SFT struggles to generalize to unfamiliar or complex tool use scenarios... we present the first comprehensive study on reward design for tool selection and application tasks within the RL paradigm... achieving a 17% improvement over base models and a 15% gain over SFT models

title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey on Agentic RAG
key_points: 论文指出传统 RAG 系统受静态工作流限制，缺乏多步推理与复杂任务管理所需的适应性。
Agentic RAG 通过嵌入自主 AI 智能体，利用反思（reflection）、规划（planning）、工具使用（tool use）、多智能体协作等 agentic 设计模式，动态管理检索策略。
论文提出基于智能体基数、控制结构、自主性、知识表示的分类法，并对现有框架的设计权衡做比较分析。
raw_excerpt: traditional RAG systems are constrained by static workflows and lack the adaptability required for multi-step reasoning and complex task management... These agents leverage agentic design patterns reflection, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration to dynamically manage retrieval strategies

title: From LLM Reasoning to Autonomous AI Agents: A Comprehensive Review
key_points: 论文系统整合 2019-2025 的基准，提出约 60 个基准的分类法，覆盖通用/学术知识推理、数学问题求解、代码生成与软件工程、事实落地与检索、领域特定评估、多模态与具身任务、任务编排、交互评估。
论文回顾了 2023-2025 年间引入的 AI-agent 框架，这些框架将 LLM 与模块化工具包集成，以实现自主决策与多步推理。
论文综述了三种智能体协作协议：Agent Communication Protocol (ACP)、Model Context Protocol (MCP)、Agent-to-Agent Protocol (A2A)。
论文列出的未来研究方向包括：通过强化学习实现动态工具集成（dynamic tool integration via reinforcement learning）、集成搜索能力、多智能体失败模式、智能体协议的安全漏洞。
raw_excerpt: we review AI-agent frameworks introduced between 2023 and 2025 that integrate large language models with modular toolkits to enable autonomous decision-making and multi-step reasoning... dynamic tool integration via reinforcement learning, integrated search capabilities, and security vulnerabilities in agent protocols

title: Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
key_points: 论文称 LLM-based agents 代表一次范式转变（paradigm shift），使自主系统能够规划、推理、使用工具并与动态环境交互。
论文从五个视角分析智能体评估：核心 LLM 能力（如规划、工具使用）、应用特定基准、通用智能体评估、基准核心维度、面向开发者的评估框架与工具。
论文指出当前趋势是向更真实、更具挑战性、持续更新的基准转变。
论文识别出的关键缺口包括成本效率、安全性与鲁棒性评估，以及细粒度、可扩展评估方法的开发。
raw_excerpt: LLM-based agents represent a paradigm shift in AI, enabling autonomous systems to plan, reason, and use tools while interacting with dynamic environments... Core LLM capabilities needed for agentic workflows, like planning, and tool use

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (arXiv:2210.03629v3)
key_points: 论文标题为 ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models，作者为 Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao。
v3 为 ICLR camera-ready 版本（2023-03-10 修订），仅修正了若干笔误。
论文在问答任务 HotpotQA 与事实核查任务 FEVER 上评估 ReAct，并与 chain-of-thought 推理基线对比。
摘要称 ReAct 通过与简单 Wikipedia API 交互，克服了 chain-of-thought 推理中普遍存在的幻觉（hallucination）与错误传播（error propagation）问题。
摘要称在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个交互式决策基准上，ReAct 相比模仿学习与强化学习方法分别取得 34% 与 10% 的绝对成功率提升，且仅使用一至两个 in-context 示例。
raw_excerpt: Concretely, on question answering (HotpotQA) and fact verification (Fever), ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning by interacting with a simple Wikipedia API... On two interactive decision making benchmarks (ALFWorld and WebShop), ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models — Project Site
key_points: 项目主页说明 ReAct prompt 由 few-shot 任务求解轨迹构成，包含人工书写的文本推理轨迹、动作以及环境对动作的观测（observations）。
主页称 ReAct prompting 在从问答到在线购物等多种任务上取得 state-of-the-art few-shot 表现（属作者自述的营销性主张，未给出具体数值）。
主页以 HotpotQA 为例说明：仅推理基线（chain-of-thought）因未接地于外部环境而受错误信息影响；仅行动基线因缺乏推理无法综合出最终答案；ReAct 则以可解释且有事实依据的轨迹解决任务。
主页提及 ReAct 微调（finetuning）在 HotpotQA 上的初步结果：ReAct 是各模型规模下最佳的微调格式，且 ReAct 微调的小模型可超过 prompt 的大模型。
raw_excerpt: A ReAct prompt consists of few-shot task-solving trajectories, with human-written text reasoning traces and actions, as well as environment observations in response to actions... The reason-only baseline (i.e. chain-of-thought) suffers from misinformation (in red) as it is not grounded to external environments

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (arXiv:2210.03629v3, ICLR camera-ready)
key_points: 论文摘要明确：在两个交互式决策基准 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，ReAct 相对 imitation 和 reinforcement learning 方法分别取得 34% 和 10% 的绝对成功率提升（absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively）。
该提升是在仅使用 1 到 2 个 in-context 示例（one or two in-context examples）的提示设置下取得的。
论文将 reasoning（如 chain-of-thought prompting）与 acting（如 action plan generation）作为此前被分开研究的两项能力，ReAct 以交错（interleaved）方式同时生成 reasoning traces 与 task-specific actions。
v3 为 ICLR camera-ready 版本，仅修正了若干笔误（typos fixed）。
raw_excerpt: On two interactive decision making benchmarks (ALFWorld and WebShop), ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively, while being prompted with only one or two in-context examples.

项目页未给出 ALFWorld / WebShop 上 CoT、act-only、ReAct 的具体成功率数字。

The act-only baseline suffers from the lack of reasoning, unable to synthesize the final answer despite having the same actions and observation as ReAct in this case.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (arXiv:2210.03629v3, ICLR camera-ready)
key_points: 论文摘要明确主张：在 HotpotQA 与 Fever 上，ReAct 通过与简单 Wikipedia API 交互，克服了 chain-of-thought 推理中普遍存在的 hallucination（幻觉）与 error propagation（错误传播）问题。
论文将 reasoning（如 chain-of-thought prompting）与 acting（如 action plan generation）描述为此前被分开研究的两项能力，ReAct 以交错方式生成二者。
v3 为 ICLR camera-ready 版本（2023-03-10 修订），仅修正了若干笔误。
raw_excerpt: Concretely, on question answering (HotpotQA) and fact verification (Fever), ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning by interacting with a simple Wikipedia API, and generates human-like task-solving trajectories that are more interpretable than baselines without reasoning traces.

title: ReAct Project Site (react-lm.github.io)
key_points: 项目页对 HotpotQA 示例给出定性失败归因：reason-only 基线（即 chain-of-thought）因未接地到外部环境、只能依赖有限的内部知识，而「suffers from misinformation」（受错误信息困扰）。
项目页对 act-only 基线给出定性失败归因：尽管拥有与 ReAct 相同的动作与观察，但「suffers from the lack of reasoning」（缺乏推理），无法综合出最终答案。
项目页称 ReAct 以可解释且事实性的轨迹解决了该任务。
项目页另给出 ALFWorld 上的一个失败示例，说明 ReAct 并非完美，但其格式便于人工检查与行为纠正。
raw_excerpt: The reason-only baseline (i.e. chain-of-thought) suffers from misinformation (in red) as it is not grounded to external environments to obtain and update knowledge, and has to rely on limited internal knowledge. The act-only baseline suffers from the lack of reasoning, unable to synthesize the final answer despite having the same actions and observation as ReAct in this case.

title: LangGraph v1 release notes — Deprecation of create_react_agent
key_points: LangGraph v1 官方发布说明设有专门小节「Deprecation of create_react_agent」。
官方原文：LangGraph 的 create_react_agent 预构建组件已被弃用，转而推荐 LangChain 的 create_agent。
官方给出的弃用理由：create_agent 提供更简单的接口，并通过引入 middleware（中间件）提供更强的定制能力。
LangGraph v1 与 LangChain v1 配套：LangChain 的 create_agent 构建在 LangGraph 之上。
官方建议：用 LangChain 快速起步，需要自定义编排时下沉到 LangGraph。
raw_excerpt: Deprecation of create_react_agent — The LangGraph create_react_agent prebuilt has been deprecated in favor of LangChain's create_agent. It provides a simpler interface, and offers greater customization potential through the introduction of middleware.

title: LangChain v1 release notes — create_agent
key_points: LangChain v1 官方原文：create_agent 是 LangChain 中构建 agent 的新标准，取代 langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent。
create_agent 相比 langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent 提供更简单的接口，并通过 middleware 提供更强的定制潜力。
官方描述 create_agent 底层机制为「basic agent loop」：调用模型 → 让模型选择要执行的工具 → 当模型不再调用工具时结束。
LangChain v1 将 langchain 命名空间精简，遗留功能迁移到 langchain-classic。
Middleware 被官方称为 create_agent 的定义性特性，暴露 before_agent / before_model / wrap_model_call / wrap_tool_call / after_model / after_agent 等钩子。
raw_excerpt: create_agent — The new standard for building agents in LangChain, replacing langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent. ... Under the hood, create_agent is built on the basic agent loop — calling a model, letting it choose tools to execute, and then finishing when it calls no more tools.

title: LangChain Agents documentation — create_agent as the agent harness
key_points: 官方对 agent 的定义：agent 是一个在循环中调用工具直到任务完成的模型（a model calling tools in a loop until a given task is complete）。
官方将 harness 定义为循环之外的一切：prompt、tools 以及塑造模型行为的 middleware；公式为 Agent = Model + Harness。
官方称 create_agent 是一个高度可配置的 harness，通过 model=、tools=、system_prompt= 参数配置基础能力，通过 middleware 扩展高级能力。
当前官方文档的 agent 构造入口为 from langchain.agents import create_agent，文档中未出现 create_react_agent 作为推荐用法。
官方区分层级：Deep Agents 构建在 create_agent 之上（含 planning、filesystem tools、subagents、memory）；需要自行配置 harness 时使用 create_agent。
raw_excerpt: An agent is a model calling tools in a loop until a given task is complete. A harness is everything around that loop: the prompt, the tools, and any middleware that shapes the model's behavior. Agent = Model + Harness ... create_agent is a highly configurable harness.

title: LangGraph Overview — positioning of LangGraph vs LangChain agents
key_points: 官方将 LangGraph 定位为低层编排框架与运行时（low-level orchestration framework and runtime），用于构建长时运行、有状态的 agent。
官方原文：若刚接触 agent 或想要更高层抽象，推荐使用 LangChain 的 agents，其提供针对常见 LLM 与 tool-calling 循环的预构建架构（prebuilt architectures for common LLM and tool-calling loops）。
官方产品分层：Deep Agents 是 agent harness；LangChain 是 agent framework（模型、工具、agent 循环的抽象与集成）；LangGraph 是 orchestration runtime（持久执行、流式、human-in-the-loop、持久化）。
LangGraph 不抽象 prompt 或架构，强调将确定性步骤与 LLM 驱动的 agentic 步骤混合在同一图中。
raw_excerpt: If you are just getting started with agents or want a higher-level abstraction, we recommend you use LangChain's agents that provide prebuilt architectures for common LLM and tool-calling loops. ... LangChain is the agent framework: abstractions and integrations for models, tools, and agent loops.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK — Running agents (official docs)
key_points: OpenAI Agents SDK 通过 Runner 类运行 agent，提供 Runner.run()、Runner.run_sync()、Runner.run_streamed() 三种方法。
官方文档明确描述了一个 'agent loop'：调用 LLM → LLM 产出输出 → 若被判定为最终输出则结束循环并返回结果 → 若 LLM 请求 handoff 则更新当前 agent 与输入并重跑循环 → 若 LLM 产生 tool calls 则执行工具、追加结果并重跑循环。
循环终止条件为：LLM 产出期望类型的文本输出且不含 tool calls。
存在 max_turns 轮次上限，超出则抛出 MaxTurnsExceeded 异常；传 max_turns=None 可禁用轮次限制。
该循环以 LLM 原生 tool calling 与 handoff 为核心控制流，文档未将其命名为 ReAct。
raw_excerpt: The runner then runs a loop: We call the LLM for the current agent, with the current input. The LLM produces its output. If the runner classifies the LLM's output as final output, the loop ends and we return the result. If the LLM requests a handoff, we update the current agent and input, and re-run the loop. If the LLM produces tool calls, we run those tool calls, append the results, and re-run the loop.

title: LlamaIndex — Deploying Agents (official docs)
key_points: LlamaIndex 将 agent 定义为使用 LLM、memory 和 tools 处理外部用户输入的系统。
官方文档描述 agent 调用会启动一个特定循环：agent 获取最新消息+聊天历史 → 工具 schema 与聊天历史发送到 API → agent 返回直接回复或工具调用列表 → 执行每个工具调用 → 工具结果加入聊天历史 → 再次调用 agent（返回直接回复或选择更多调用）。
文档明确区分：FunctionAgent 使用 LLM provider 的 function/tool calling 能力执行工具；而 ReActAgent 和 CodeActAgent 使用不同的 prompting 策略执行工具。
LlamaIndex 默认所有 agent 使用 ChatMemoryBuffer 作为 memory。
raw_excerpt: The FunctionAgent is a type of agent that uses an LLM provider's function/tool calling capabilities to execute tools. Other types of agents, such as ReActAgent and CodeActAgent, use different prompting strategies to execute tools.

title: LlamaIndex — Building an agent (official docs)
key_points: LlamaIndex 将 agent 描述为：给定任务与一组工具，选择最佳可用工具完成每一步；每步完成后 agent 判断任务是否完成——完成则返回结果，未完成则循环回到起点。
LlamaIndex 提供预构建 agentic workflows，如 FunctionAgent（简单的 function/tool calling agent）与 AgentWorkflow（可管理多 agent）。
官方教程以 FunctionAgent 作为构建 function calling agent 的默认示例。
raw_excerpt: It is given a set of tools ... and it selects the best available tool to complete each step. When each step is completed, the agent judges whether the task is now complete, in which case it returns a result to the user, or whether it needs to take another step, in which case it loops back to the start.

title: AutoGen AgentChat — Agents tutorial (official docs)
key_points: AutoGen AgentChat 提供一组预设 Agent，各自在如何响应消息上有所不同；所有 agent 共享 name、description、run、run_stream 等属性与方法。
AssistantAgent 是内置 agent，使用语言模型并具备使用工具的能力；官方将其标注为面向原型与教学用途的 'kitchen sink' agent，并建议理解设计后自行实现 agent。
文档示例中 agent.run() 返回的 TaskResult 消息序列为：TextMessage(user) → ToolCallRequestEvent → ToolCallExecutionEvent → ToolCallSummaryMessage，即 LLM 请求工具调用、执行工具、汇总结果的循环。
文档指出：与 v0.2 AgentChat 不同，工具由同一个 agent 在同一次 run() 调用内直接执行。
run() 会更新 agent 内部状态（将消息加入消息历史）。
raw_excerpt: Unlike in v0.2 AgentChat, the tools are executed by the same agent directly within the same call to run().
